candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, to Lakkum. It ended at the Jordan.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: The border turned westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there to Hukkok. It reached to Zebulun on the south, and reached to Asher on the west, and to Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise.
